text_block_list.text:
Debut day has finally arrived! As for 
Shinko Windy...
(Fidget... Fidget...)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: *CHOMP---!!*

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gyahaha, gyahahahaha! This is 
hilarious...!

"A gentle nibble from the lion dance. It 
doesn't hurt. It's probably doing it just 
to hide its restlessness. Just then—"
Knock knock♪ Pardon the intrusion~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, here I am☆ How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Y-You guys...! Did you come to see 
Windy-chan?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's your big debut, after all. I'm 
rooting for you, Windy-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I told you I'd keep watching, 
didn't I? I'm curious about this evil 
Umamusume's true strength. This is all to 
protect the peace!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Those three from the other day are in the 
stands too. Rickey-chan, Tarumae-chan, and 
Acute-san♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Having a whole crowd show up here would be 
a bit much, right? So Falco and friends 
came as representativesâ

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Oho... You all wanna see 
Windy-chan that badly, huh~

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it is Windy-chan's momentous debut 
race, after all. It's only natural to be 
curious. Fufufuuun♪"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Senpai... You seem pretty cheerful, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I was certain you were scheming something 
again, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
She must be really thrilled about her 
debut!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...! I-it's more like I'm happy, 
or...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I-It is a matter of joy! For this is the 
first step toward Windy-chan's conquest of 
the racing world!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
D-Domination, you say...!? Are you 
planning something evil after all?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph! I've got a super evil plan that I 
may... or may not be cooking up, so 
there!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Guhh! If push comes to shove... Justice 
Biko will stop it with everything she's 
got!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Good grief...☆ It's almost post time~.
